string.name: about_feedback_scope
string.value: Scope: report problems with the toolbox itself (a tool computing the wrong result, a broken screen) in this repository. Questions about how to use the framework belong in the framework repository, where its maintainers will see them.

string.name: about_framework_intro
string.value: This app runs on NGF (Neon Genesis Framework) and is open-sourced as its official sample. Each tool demonstrates one layer of the framework — reading this repository is the fastest way to learn how NGF fits together.

string.name: about_layers_note
string.value: The framework also ships media playback, push, hardware sensors, a web bridge and more. This app does not use them, so they are not listed here — listing them would suggest the sample demonstrates them.

string.name: about_license
string.value: MIT licensed · completely free · no ads, no in-app purchases

string.name: about_privacy_note
string.value: These are not slogans: every line can be checked against the code and module.json5 in the repository.
